title: Rosary Mystery Coverage Balance
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`faith:rosary`), retreat events (`faith:retreat`), attendance logs (`faith:attendance`), fasting journals (`faith:fast`), practice reviews (`faith:ops`).
app: Spiritual-practice telemetry — rosary counters, meditation-retreat schedules, church-attendance logs, and fasting journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=faith:rosary mystery=*
| stats count as items by mystery
| eventstats sum(items) as total
| eval share_pct=round(100*items/total,1)
| sort - share_pct
description: Shows how rosary sessions split across mystery for mystery coverage.
value: Share-of-total views make it easier to see imbalance, over-concentration, and neglected areas inside mystery coverage.
implementation: Capture each rosary sessions event in `faith:rosary` and normalize `mystery` so Splunk can compute the share by mystery.
visualization: Table of mystery with item count and share percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how rosary sessions are divided across mystery so you can tell if one part of mystery coverage is taking over.
